segments.text: Most beginners watch hours of theory and never build anything.

segments.text: Today we build one real project together: predicting flat prices in Bangalore. Follow along.
segments.caption: Today we build one real project together: predicting flat prices in Bangalore. Follow along.

segments.text: Step one, problem definition: write one sentence.
segments.caption: Step 1, problem definition: write one sentence.

segments.text: Predict the flat price in lakhs, using area, bedrooms, location and age. Success means being off by less than eight lakh on average.
segments.caption: Predict the flat price in lakhs, using area, bedrooms, location and age. Success means being off by less than 8 lakh on average.

segments.text: If you can't write this sentence, don't start coding.
segments.caption: If you can't write this sentence, don't start coding.

segments.text: Step two, data collection: get the data.
segments.caption: Step 2, data collection: get the data.

segments.text: Free sources: Kaggle, data dot gov dot in, or your own spreadsheet.
segments.caption: Free sources: Kaggle, data.gov.in, or your own spreadsheet.

segments.text: For a first project, a few thousand rows is plenty.
segments.caption: For a first project, a few thousand rows is plenty.

segments.text: Load it with pandas, using read csv. We have ten thousand flats.
segments.caption: Load it with pandas, using read_csv. We have 10,000 flats.

segments.text: Step three, data cleaning: run these four checks, every single time.
segments.caption: Step 3, data cleaning: run these 4 checks, every single time.

segments.text: One, missing values: is null, sum.
segments.caption: 1, missing values: isnull().sum().

segments.text: Two, duplicates: drop duplicates.
segments.caption: 2, duplicates: drop_duplicates().

segments.text: Three, impossible values: describe. Twelve thousand square feet with one bedroom? Probably a typo.
segments.caption: 3, impossible values: describe(). 12,000 sq ft with 1 bedroom? Probably a typo.

segments.text: Four, outliers. One fifty crore villa will confuse a flat price model.
segments.caption: 4, outliers. One 50 crore villa will confuse a flat price model.

segments.text: Then fix them: fill missing values with the median, delete the duplicates, and correct or remove the typos.
segments.caption: Then fix them: fill missing values with the median, delete the duplicates, and correct or remove the typos.

segments.text: Step four, exploratory data analysis, or E D A: make three plots before any model.
segments.caption: Step 4, exploratory data analysis, or EDA: make 3 plots before any model.

segments.text: Price versus area. Average price by area of the city. And a histogram of prices.
segments.caption: Price versus area. Average price by area of the city. And a histogram of prices.

segments.text: Here, price climbs steadily with size, and Koramangala costs the most.
segments.caption: Here, price climbs steadily with size, and Koramangala costs the most.

segments.text: Step five, the train test split: split before you train.
segments.caption: Step 5, the train-test split: split before you train.

segments.text: Train test split, with test size zero point two. Then lock the test set away until the very end.
segments.caption: train_test_split, with test_size = 0.2. Then lock the test set away until the very end.

segments.text: Step six, model training: start simple.
segments.caption: Step 6, model training: start simple.

segments.text: Linear regression, in three lines: create the model, fit it on the training data, and predict. Fancy models can wait.
segments.caption: Linear regression, in 3 lines: create the model, fit it on the training data, and predict. Fancy models can wait.

segments.text: Step seven, model evaluation: compare with a dumb baseline.
segments.caption: Step 7, model evaluation: compare with a dumb baseline.

segments.text: Just guessing the average price is off by twenty-two lakh. Our model is off by seven. That's under our target of eight. It works!
segments.caption: Just guessing the average price is off by 22 lakh. Our model is off by 7. That's under our target of 8. It works!

segments.text: That number is the mean absolute error: on average, how far each prediction is from the real price.
segments.caption: That number is the mean absolute error: on average, how far each prediction is from the real price.
